test_chrono_system_clock: test that m.test_chrono1 returns a datetime matching the current system clock
test_chrono_system_clock_roundtrip: test that m.test_chrono2 roundtrips a datetime through C++ without losing precision
test_chrono_duration_roundtrip: test that m.test_chrono3 roundtrips a timedelta through C++ and preserves days seconds and microseconds
test_chrono_duration_subtraction_equival: test that m.test_chrono4 computes the same duration as subtracting two datetimes in Python
test_floating_point_duration: test that m.test_chrono7 converts a float in seconds to a timedelta with correct precision
